newsitem.title: USA: Bentley gets ulcer drug approval in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Bentley gets ulcer drug approval in Spain.

text.p: Bentley Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Monday that it has received marketing approval for its Belmazol ulcer treatment in Spain.
The Spanish Ministry of Health approved a new 28-capsule presentation of Belmazol, which is used primarily for hyperacidity problems related to ulcers and gastroesophageal reflux disease.
Bentley said it is preparing to launch the product in early April 1997.
Bentley's sales of Belmazol accounted for approximately $4.5 million of its 1996 revenues, the company said.
Bentley said the new 28-capsule presentation should allow it to accelerate the rate of its market share growth and management expects sales of Belmazol to exceed $6.5 million in 1997.
Belmazol's enzyme system acts to block the final step of gastric acid production, Bentley said.
This compound has been used in combination with antibiotics for the treatment of ulcers when it is suspected that Helicobacter pylori, a bacteria, is causing the ailment.
